title: This Fish Tricks a Mother Into Raising Babies That Eat Hers

scenes.text: One fish tricks another fish into raising its babies. And hers don't survive.
It's the cuckoo catfish, and it lives in Lake Tanganyika, Africa.
Mouthbrooding cichlids lay eggs and scoop them into their mouths to protect them.
Just then, the catfish rushes in, eats some eggs, and drops its own look-alike eggs in their place.
The mother scoops them up too. The catfish eggs hatch faster, and the fry eat her eggs and young from inside her mouth.
The cuckoo catfish never raises a single baby. It lets its victim do it.

description:
A fish tricks a mother into raising its babies, and they eat hers.
The cuckoo catfish drops look-alike eggs among a cichlid's eggs. She carries them in her mouth, where the catfish hatch first and eat her young.
Would you have spotted the trick? Comment below.
